description: Fixture pack for magician-decision tests: a browser-step-shaped trio with one dynamic Choice (empty criteria until candidates are injected).

questions.instructions: The page has finished loading relative to the last action (no pending spinner or mid-navigation state)
Which candidate element best advances the goal now
Which mechanical verb applies to the chosen element

criteria.click: A plain click activates the element
criteria.select: The element is an option to select
criteria.scroll: More of the page must be revealed before acting
criteria.none_of_these: The step needs typing, navigation, or a plan change
